label: Transfer Pricing Documentation (Accounting)
description: Structures transfer pricing documentation for intra-group transactions. Covers functional analysis, comparability analysis, method selection, and documentation to OECD/BEPS standards.

claudeKnowledge.description: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines 2022, BEPS Actions 8-10 and 13, EU JTPF guidelines, Nordic transfer pricing rules and case law

options.label: Both Master File and Local File

guidedInputs.label: Group structure and overview
guidedInputs.placeholder: Describe the multinational group: parent entity, subsidiaries, jurisdictions, ownership structure, consolidated revenue, and primary business activities.

guidedInputs.label: Intercompany transactions to document
guidedInputs.placeholder:
List the intra-group transactions requiring documentation:
e.g.
1. Management services: Swedish parent charges Nordic subsidiaries management fee (EUR 2.5M p.a.)
2. IP licence: Swedish parent licenses brand to all group entities (royalty 2% of revenue)
3. Intercompany loan: Swedish parent lends EUR 10M to Finnish subsidiary at 4.5% p.a.
4. IT services: Polish shared service centre charges all entities for IT support

guidedInputs.label: Value chain description
guidedInputs.placeholder: Where are key functions performed? Where are significant assets held (tangible and intangible)? Which entities bear the key risks? Describe the overall value creation story of the group.

guidedInputs.label: Existing transfer pricing policies
guidedInputs.placeholder: Describe any existing TP policies, pricing methodologies, or previous documentation. Upload documents via files panel.

guidedInputs.label: Key jurisdictions and their requirements
guidedInputs.placeholder:
List jurisdictions involved and any specific local requirements, recent audits, or advance pricing agreements.
e.g. Sweden (primary), Finland, Denmark, Poland, Netherlands (IP holding), Germany (major sales entity)
